answer.says: Ramesh, you are right. The pot is empty because I have not provided the means, and the fault is mine, not yours. You shall be paid from my own pocket, not the Directorate's imprest. I will settle the account now, so that the spirit of the household may move again. Sit, and wait.
answer.thought: The tension is clear: the stove is hot, but the pot is empty because the material cause is missing. I cannot demand the effect without the condition. I must restore the relation between the universal (the house) and the particular (the meal) by paying what is owed, even if it empties my pocket. This is the discipline of the ethical life, applied to the kitchen.
